reviewed_discrepancies.explanation: The Python process loaded scale_run.py and saved harness/scale_run.py before setup. The live disk file was then amended to capture MySQL Bytes_sent/received and AMQP connection octets before provenance read its hash. The run executed the preserved earlier snapshot, not the later disk version. The only diff adds network observation before/after k6; SEND model, budgets, deadlines and server source are unchanged. Original environment.json and manifest are preserved. This run has no broker-network.json and no MySQL byte counters; those remain uncollected. Future provenance separately records executed snapshot hashes.
reviewed_discrepancies.review: Compared complete unified diff of the snapshot and later disk source; original mismatch report retained in scale-evidence-verification-first.json.
